attchmntText: Bharati Defence and Infrastructure Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Bharati Defence and Infrastructure Limited approved its unaudited financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, during a board meeting on November 13, 2026. The company reported a net profit of 356.00 lakhs for the quarter, compared to 495.25 lakhs in the same period of the previous year. For the half-year ended September 30, 2026, the net profit stood at 522.71 lakhs against 578.76 lakhs in the prior year. Revenue from operations for the quarter was 1,385.43 lakhs, up from 2,190.98 lakhs in the corresponding quarter last year. Basic earnings per share were 0.71 for the quarter and 1.04 for the half-year. The company is currently undergoing capital restructuring, including share capital reduction. The results are subject to a limited review report.
